exploration.title: Harness the Harness: Claude Code for Lawyers Without the Setup
openQuestions: Q1 Wrap vehicle: Claude Desktop/Code extensions only (mcpb gateway + practice-claude-mod), or an own t3code-style desktop app?
Q2 Bootstrap: how does a lawyer get from nothing to a running onboarding agent (signed bootstrapper vs manual Claude install first)?
Q3 Gateway shape: grow practice-kg-mcp into the one gateway, or a new gateway that mounts practice-kg as one provider?
Q4 Proving ground: clean Windows VM first, the attorney's PC re-onboarded, or a second firm?
Q5 Adoption data: buy the ABA 2024 Legal Technology Survey volumes (money) or rely on free sources plus attorney interviews?
